methodology.windowCaveat: The claim of '90-day production caller evidence' could not be substantiated. gcloud logging buckets list --location=global shows the _Default log bucket (which holds Cloud Run/Cloud Functions request and execution logs) has retention_days=30, not 90. Only the _Required bucket (400 days) goes back further, and it holds Admin Activity audit logs (deploys, IAM, config changes) — not invocation/request logs. The true observable evidence window for caller traffic is therefore 30 days, and this census reports that real window rather than repeating the unverified 90-day figure.
